flags.why: Quần vợt is a standard name for tennis that can be used in ordinary conversation, so the formal tag is misleading.
Thi triển has a literary register, especially associated with descriptions of martial arts or extraordinary abilities, rather than neutral everyday speech.
Hùm is a general literary word for tiger rather than a specifically Central regional word ([dictionary entry](https://vdict.com/h%C3%B9m,3,0,0.html)).

The entry omits the common conversational and entertainment sense of exchanging remarks and playing off another speaker ([usage example](https://vov.vn/van-hoa-giai-tri/on-gioi-tap-7-day-doi-truong-giang-duc-phuc-lam-hoai-linh-than-phuc-718562.vov)).
flags.fix: Add: verb | to exchange witty remarks; to play off one another in conversation. Example: Hai MC tung hứng rất ăn ý. = The two hosts play off each other very well.
